login.title: Log in to Poolstation
login.intro: Log in with the e-mail address and password of your Poolstation account (poolstation.net).
login.code_intro: Poolstation sent a login code to your e-mail. Enter it below.
login.missing: Enter your e-mail address and password

warning.unreachable: Poolstation is temporarily unreachable, showing the last known values

error.login_failed: Login failed: check your e-mail address and password
error.login_500: Login failed. Poolstation answers a wrong e-mail address or password with a server error; please check your details.
error.code_invalid: The login code is wrong or has expired
error.no_pools: No pools found in this Poolstation account
error.pool_not_in_account: This pool does not belong to the account you logged in with
error.reauth: Your Poolstation login has expired. Choose 'Repair' on the device to log in again.
error.reauth_2fa: Poolstation asks for a login code. Choose 'Repair' on the device to log in again.
error.write_failed: Changing the setting in Poolstation failed
error.not_supported: This pool does not have this feature
error.relay_unknown: This relay was not found in Poolstation
